newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore government securities end narrowly mixed.
newsitem.headline: Singapore government securities end narrowly mixed.

text.p: Singapore government securities ended narrowly mixed in moderate trade on retail and interbank interest, dealers said on Friday.

"Government securities were narrowly mixed today amid uncertainty over the near-term direction of the market. Treasury bill yields were slightly lower but bond prices were narrowly mixed. The interbank rate was unchanged and volume was moderate," a local dealer said.
In treasury bills, three-months closed at a yield of 1.48/1.43 percent compared with Thursday's yield of 1.53/1.48 percent.
One-year closed at a yield of 1.65/1.60 against Thursday's 1.73/1.68 percent.
Among bonds, April 1998 ended at S$99.53/99.63 from Thursday's close of S$99.55/99.60, September 2001 at S$96.73/96.83 versus S$96.73/96.78 and June 2003 at S$94.75/94.85 against S$94.73/94.78.
The interbank rate was unchanged from Thursday's 3-3/8 3-1/4 percent.
